ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is the “particle source”; the particle enters from left to right into the accelerating region formed by two vertical plates, and this region is marked with voltage U1; afterward the particle exits from the small hole S and enters between the parallel metal plates on the right side along the midline shown by the dashed line. The upper plate on the right side is labeled A, and the lower plate is labeled B; between the two plates there is a voltage U2 marked in the vertical direction, and the horizontal length of the plates is labeled L. The problem text supplements that the distance between the two plates is d, and the particle is incident along the midline. Then reason: The initial velocity of the particle can be neglected. After passing through the accelerating voltage U1, it obtains horizontal velocity v. From the energy relation, qU1 = 1/2 mv^2, so v^2 = 2qU1/m. After entering between plates A and B, it moves uniformly in the horizontal direction. The uniform electric field strength between the plates is E = U2/d, and the magnitude of the vertical acceleration is a = qE/m = qU2/(md). The time for the particle to move between the plates is t = L/v. In order to be able to fly out from between the two plates, its vertical displacement must be less than the distance from the midline to either plate, d/2, namely 1/2 a t^2 < d/2. Substitute a and t: 1/2 · qU2/(md) · L^2/v^2 < d/2. Then substitute v^2 = 2qU1/m, obtaining U2 L^2/(4dU1) < d/2, therefore U2/U1 < 2d^2/L^2.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读取：粒子源在左侧，粒子经电压为U1的加速区后由小孔S进入右侧两块平行金属板A、B之间；虚线表示入射路径在两板中线处，板间区域长度为L，板间有偏转电压U2。再从题文读取：初速度可忽略，板间距为d，粒子必须能从两板间飞出。求解时用能量关系确定进入偏转场的水平速度：qU1=1/2 mv^2。板间匀强电场强度E=U2/d，竖直加速度a=qE/m=qU2/(md)。粒子在板间运动时间t=L/v，最大允许偏移量为d/2，因此要求1/2 a t^2<d/2。将v^2=2qU1/m代入，消去q、m，得到U2/U1<2d^2/L^2。
